subject: general
question: Find the area of an isosceles triangle whose base is 54 cm long and each equal side is 45 cm long.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an **isosceles triangle**, the **altitude** to the **base** bisects the base into two equal parts of 27 cm each (54 ÷ 2 = 27).

Using **Pythagorean triplet** (9, 12, 15) scaled by 3 → (27, 36, 45).

Height (h) = 36 cm.

Area = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 54 × 36 = 27 × 36 = 972 sq.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 972 sq.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base** (b) = 54 cm

**Equal sides** (a) = 45 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of **Isosceles Triangle** = (b/4) × √(4a² − b²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e206e5a3c9aa2974bcf3a76d86f953caaf2ac1b94141f331ede0f02560e1a7a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (54/4) × √(4 × 45² − 54²)

⇒ Area = 13.5 × √(4 × 2025 − 2916)

⇒ Area = 13.5 × √(8100 − 2916)

⇒ Area = 13.5 × √5184

⇒ Area = 13.5 × 72

⇒ Area = 972 sq.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 972 sq.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

For a triangle with sides a, b, c and semi-perimeter s = (a+b+c)/2, Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

Height of Isosceles Triangle

The altitude (h) drawn to the base (b) of an isosceles triangle with equal sides (a) is given by h = √(a² − (b/2)²).

Properties of Isosceles Triangle

The angles opposite to the equal sides are equal, and the altitude to the base bisects both the base and the vertex angle.</p
